_comment: ADR-0041 §B.4, §H. Applied by T10 to the Loki bucket (handsontable-demos-o11y-loki) via `wrangler r2 bucket lifecycle` / the R2 API. Retention through R2 lifecycle, not the Loki compactor (compactor.retention_enabled stays false — its markers would live on ephemeral disk). Age is in seconds. Confirmed against the real key layout Loki 3.3.2 writes (T01 spike, containers/o11y/local/stop-roundtrip.mjs): browser/<fp>/..., worker/<fp>/..., index/index/<table>/..., state/wakes/<wakeId>/clean.
